_comment: Tier-2 for sparta (all physics): every generator the catalog advertises is generated, validated, data-staged and RUN on the installed binary — 12 variants across 10 physics rows, all rc=0. Also gates payload hygiene: get_knowledge() must contain no absolute host path (the old 'installed_build' block hard-coded four) and every pitfall must carry a Signal: clause. The binary part skips cleanly when SPARTA is absent; the hygiene part always runs.
